fusions.name: Locked Gaze
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. Fires a bolt that hits the first enemy in its path for 7 damage and leaves it [Inescapable] for 4 seconds, unable to teleport or step aside.

fusions.name: Portcullis Drop
fusions.desc: Bars drop around you, dealing 26 damage that ignores resistances to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and leaving each [Suppressed] for 3 seconds, its abilities out of reach.

fusions.name: Every Door Shut
fusions.desc: Holds every creature within 6 tiles in place for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Nowhere to Go
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, you deal 12% more damage.
